Design requirement: Stored new-case waveform bytes shall be digest-verified before use
Historical unverified cases shall never be silently marked valid
NPZ shall have bounded declared data size and allowed members
Normalized duplicate CSV columns shall be rejected
Explicit identifiable CSV header variants shall be blocked
Research CSV outputs shall escape potentially executable spreadsheet text
Failing audit/event integrity shall trigger review rather than green status
No research test output shall grant medical-use authorization
Missing benchmark files shall not be treated as complete validation
Local readiness report must be create-only and avoid raw waveforms
Authenticated clinician accounts and least privilege
Verification: Independent hospital integration and security tests

Design requirement: Encryption and retention for identifiable patient data
Verification: Threat model and data protection impact assessment

Design requirement: Predefined clinical accuracy thresholds per indication
Independent clinical validation and human factors
Verification: Prospective approved study and observed use

Design requirement: Clinical sponsor approved intended use and risk class
